title: Body sprite definition
description: Maps generated body/star ids to a sprite under assets/bodies/ and says how the client animates it. Presentation only: the server never reads these (assets/README.md). The sprite folder holds sheet.png + sheet.json; a 1-frame sheet is animated by shader UV rotation instead of frame playback.

id.description: Must match the filename and the sprite folder name.

spin_speed.description: Radians/second of shader UV rotation used when the sheet has a single frame. Sign sets direction.

tint_mix.description: 0 renders the sprite untouched; 1 fully recolors its luminance with the biome/star tint.

corona.description: Suns only: blend counter-rotating copies for a churning look.

corona_spread.description: Suns only: quad size relative to the ball. Above 1 widens the fire ring around the ball without growing the ball (which stays matched to its collision circle).

biomes.description: Planet sprites: generated biomes this sprite covers. A biome listed nowhere falls back to the primitive sphere.

star_types.description: Sun sprites: generated star types this sprite covers.

station_kinds.description: Station sprites: which station kinds this sprite draws.
